name: lumina
description: Orquestração local dos projetos da Lumina (landing, app, backend).

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix lumina-backend && npm run typecheck --prefix lumina-app && npm run typecheck --prefix lumina-landing
scripts.test: npm test --prefix lumina-app && npm test --prefix lumina-backend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix lumina-backend && npm run build --prefix lumina-app && npm run build --prefix lumina-landing
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix lumina-app && npm run lint --prefix lumina-landing
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,app -c green,cyan "npm run start:dev --prefix lumina-backend" "npm run dev --prefix lumina-app"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n backend,app,landing -c green,cyan,yellow "npm run start:dev --prefix lumina-backend" "npm run dev --prefix lumina-app" "npm run dev --prefix lumina-landing"
